meta.name: gstack-cso
meta.description: GStack CSO method for broad infrastructure-first security posture review, threat areas, severity calibration, and safe remediation scope.

copy.tagline: 评估基础设施安全态势并规划修复范围
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要系统性地审查基础设施安全风险并确定修复优先级
copy.tagline_en: Assess infrastructure security posture and plan remediation scope
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a systematic review of infrastructure security risks and remediation prioritization

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照 GStack CSO 方法审查基础设施安全态势，识别威胁领域、评估严重性，并给出安全修复范围。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行广泛的安全态势审查，或涉及基础设施、认证、密钥、部署、数据暴露等风险时触发。

say.text: 请用 GStack CSO 方法审查我的 AWS 基础设施安全。
say.note: Claude 会输出威胁领域、发现、严重性等。

say.text: 检查我的 CI/CD 流水线是否存在密钥泄露风险。
say.note: Claude 会聚焦于密钥和部署安全。

howto.what_en: Claude will follow the GStack CSO method to review infrastructure-first security posture, identify threat areas, calibrate severity, and propose safe remediation scope.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a broad security posture review, or when infrastructure, auth, secrets, deployment, or data exposure risks are in scope.

say_en.text: Review my AWS infrastructure security using the GStack CSO method.
say_en.note: Claude will output threat areas, findings, severity, etc.

say_en.text: Check my CI/CD pipeline for secret exposure risks.
say_en.note: Claude will focus on secrets and deployment security.
